resources.string: This is an empathy experience, not a diagnostic tool, and it doesn\'t represent every autistic person. Text adapted from the National Autistic Society\'s Too Much Information campaign materials and autistic people\'s public accounts (sources below). This app is not affiliated with or endorsed by the National Autistic Society. All sounds are synthesised. There are no flashing effects.

For many autistic people the brain doesn\'t turn down the fridge, the clock, the plastic bag. This experience, based on autistic people\'s own accounts, puts those sounds into your room. It isn\'t a diagnosis and doesn\'t speak for every autistic person; it is not affiliated with the National Autistic Society.

Next 3–5 minutes: pin six sounds to real spots in your home, then do a small task on the tray in front of you. The sounds will slowly grow and soft colours will drift at the edge of your view. No flashing.
You can press \'Quiet now\' at any time. Try it once first.
